questions.question: Tell me about your background and your experience with Python.
questions.reference_answer: I am an Artificial Intelligence student with experience using Python for programming, machine learning, and data analysis. I have applied these skills in academic projects.

questions.question: Describe an AI project you worked on and explain your own contribution.
questions.reference_answer: I worked on an AI project involving computer vision. I helped prepare the dataset, use Python and an object detection model, and evaluate how the model identifies objects. My contribution involved implementing and testing the project's AI components.

questions.question: How do you find and fix a bug in your Python code?
questions.reference_answer: I reproduce the error, read the error message, inspect the relevant code and inputs, identify the likely cause, make a change, and test it to verify the fix.
